_comment: OS-level isolation policy for Claude Code's /sandbox feature (bubblewrap on Linux, seatbelt on macOS). From the sandboxing post: 84% fewer permission prompts when paired with auto-mode. Enable per-session with /sandbox; subprocesses inherit.

filesystem._comment: cwd is read/write by default. Add additional allowlists below.

network._comment: All outbound traffic goes through a unix-domain-socket proxy. Domains not listed below are blocked. Mirror the trusted_domains list in auto-mode.yaml.

git_credentials._comment: Scoped helper validates branch name + repo destination. SSH keys + signing keys are NEVER copied into the sandbox.

escalation._comment: When the agent hits an out-of-sandbox need, it asks the operator. No silent failures.
